messages.subject: Multivariate latent growth model
parts:
Hello,

I have recently started to learn about SEM models and latent growth models as I believe this would be the appropriate analysis for my data.

I have repeated measures for 24 variables - that could be subdivided into 3 latent variables. So I would like to perform a growth model for each of those. As well as analysing the prediction/correlation within latent variables. So a multi variable latent growth model perhaps would be the solution. But I can’t find anything on how to perform growth models with multiple variables (only find information for single analysis). Can lavaan perform this type of analysis? If so could anyone please just point me to the right direction or give me some guidance on this.

I thank you in advance!

messages.author: 5ae334deab9cdfd5
messages.subject: Re: Multivariate latent growth model
parts:
Hi Mascue,

Yes, you can do so in lavaan. I recently finished a longitudinal SEM course online and one of the topics they cover is the multivariate latent growth models.  I am still learning how to do so after the course. But the example the course I took introduce how I can link two univariate LCMs though the factors and residuals. 

I am also a beginner, so I may not be able to answer the technical stuff you might encounter. But I just want to tell you the answer is YES :)

Yuen Wan Ho
Post-doctoral Research Associate at Northeastern
